claude.performance_metric: net loss $170M (2020) vs $1,125M (2019); Warrick can-sheet mill sold to Kaiser for ~$670M
claude.rationale: P5 is coded 1 because the slice documents a realized fracture at the operations/organization interface over time: a November 2019 "new operating model" that "eliminated the business unit structure," consolidated commercial capabilities, and drove ~260 terminations ($37M charge) plus ~60 further eliminations, alongside portfolio-review facility closures (Point Comfort, Spanish smelters) with associated severance and layoffs. P4 is uncertain: the slice records divestiture of the Warrick can-sheet rolling-products business to Kaiser and other non-core sales, but does not document that these product lines could not be aligned with operating processes (incoherence) — they are portfolio/non-core divestitures without stated product/process misfit. The slice does not address the controlling-intent archetype (t1) or reconciliation of two value-capture models (t2), so both are uncertain.

gemini.performance_metric: Net loss attributable to Alcoa Corporation for 2020 was $170 million, compared with a net loss of $1,125 million in 2019.
gemini.rationale: The p4_pathway is coded as 1 because the company divested non-core product lines, specifically agreeing to sell the Warrick Rolling Mill (which produces aluminum sheet for cans) and its hazardous waste treatment business. The p5_pathway is coded as 1 because the company implemented a new operating model that 'eliminated the business unit structure,' consolidated commercial capabilities, and resulted in a $37 million charge for employee terminations and severance.

grok.rationale: p4_pathway is coded 1 because the slice documents realized product-line/operations exits: a multi-year portfolio review leading to permanent closure of the Point Comfort alumina refinery, curtailment/divestiture of the Spanish smelters with large impairments, and the November 2020 agreement to sell the Warrick can-sheet rolling mill (~$670M; ~1,170 employees transferring to Kaiser), separating that product line from retained operations. p5_pathway is coded 0 because the November 2019 new operating model is reported as a deliberate, successful streamlining that eliminated the business-unit structure, cut ~260 roles ($37M charge), and delivered $60M annual savings from Q2 2020, with no documented fracture of operations against the organization.
